titulo: Rivian’s sales pop as the company’s big R2 bet starts to pay off
cuerpo: Rivian had high hopes for its more affordable R2 vehicle - and so far, those hopes appear to be paying off. The company released its third-quarter production and delivery numbers today, reporting 19,751 vehicles produced and 19,248 delivered.
